<thought>Since the previous search returned no templates, try searching for templates that break an aryl halide and form an acyl chloride, which may correspond to the Friedel‑Crafts acylation transformation in the database.</thought>

    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(C(=O)NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N)c1",

    "functional_groups_formed": ["acyl chloride"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
